title: QB2_A#q11 carried the rejected on GZ curve terminology as the HEADING over a criterion body that had already been corrected to say between the two curves, and taught no lower bound at all
candidate_claim: Tranche 2C sections 4 and 5. The q11 heading reads Net Residual Area on GZ Curve (A 7.1.2) - misleading, and to be corrected to Net Residual Area Between Heeling and Righting-Arm Curves (A 7.1.2) or equally concise wording preserving the same technical meaning, without changing the already-correct criterion text unnecessarily. Separately, the detailed explanation must make clear that the residual area in figure A7 begins at the first intersection or equilibrium point of the heeling-arm and righting-arm curves - and must NOT claim the words angle of equilibrium are verbatim A 7.1.2 clause text. q33 is ACCEPTED on this issue and must NOT be modified merely for symmetry.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD ON BOTH, AND BOTH WERE ALREADY ON THIS REPO OWN REPORTED LIST. CORR-GPT-T2A-GRAIN-20260905 found and reported exactly these two things while correcting q27: that q11 heading was the rejected terminology surviving as a label on an otherwise-corrected proposition, and that neither q11 nor q33 teaches the LOWER bound while q27 now does. Tranche 2C is the authorisation that closes what tranche 2A deliberately left open, which is why this record carries no new instrument reading: the Grain Code as adopted by MSC.23(59) was hash-verified and read off page 5 and from figure A7 during tranche 2A, and the propositions written into q11 here are the propositions that record already established and pinned into q27. Re-asserting them from a second read would produce no new evidence and would risk a second, divergent wording of one clause.

authority.instrument: IMO resolution MSC.23(59), the International Code for the Safe Carriage of Grain in Bulk as adopted, registered SRC-GRAINCODE-MSC23-59, sha256 5b2107d304bcfd8ad6c5cc080c33a94a9d168b5aaa3895277c61134e6cad8678. Read at page 5 and at figure A7 under CORR-GPT-T2A-GRAIN-20260905; NOT re-read here, and this record says so rather than implying a fresh read.
authority.why_the_heading_was_wrong: The area under the GZ curve names the wrong object. A 7.1.2 measures the area BETWEEN two curves - the residual left after the grain heeling arm is subtracted from the righting arm. The body text beneath the heading already said exactly that, so the card was teaching the correct proposition under an incorrect label. A candidate who reads headings for structure - which is what a heading is for - carried away the rejected form.
authority.lower_bound_provenance: THE LOWER BOUND IS DERIVED, AND THE CARD NOW SAYS SO IN THE CARD, not only in this record. A 7.1.2 states only the upper bound. The word equilibrium appears NOWHERE in the Code as adopted - a full-text search of all 31 pages returned zero hits under tranche 2A. The lower bound comes from FIGURE A7, whose shaded region labelled residual dynamic stability begins at the first intersection of the heeling arm line with the righting arm curve, the vertical the figure annotates as the angle of heel due to grain shift. The corrected q11 names figure A7 as the provenance and instructs against offering angle of equilibrium as A 7.1.2 clause text.
authority.wording_matched_to_q27: The lower-bound proposition is written in the same terms CORR-GPT-T2A-GRAIN-20260905 wrote into q27: first intersection, figure A7, residual dynamic stability, and an explicit ban on quoting the phrase as clause text. Two cards teaching one clause in two wordings is the defect this tranche exists to close, so the wording was matched deliberately rather than re-derived.

supersedes.note: CORR-GPT-T1-GRAIN-20260904 corrected this card criterion TEXT from the one-limb up to 40 degrees form to the least-of-three form. It did not correct the HEADING above that text, and it did not add the lower bound. Both were reported by the following tranche and are closed here.

changed_propositions: Body heading: Net Residual Area on GZ Curve (A 7.1.2) -> Net Residual Area Between Heeling and Righting-Arm Curves (A 7.1.2). The heading only; the criterion sentence beneath it was already correct and is byte-identical.

Body criterion bullet: a closing sentence ADDED after the existing never reduce it to the area up to 40 degrees instruction, stating that the LOWER bound is not in the clause at all, that A 7.1.2 states only the upper limit, that the lower bound comes from figure A7 which shades the residual dynamic stability area from the FIRST INTERSECTION of the heeling arm line with the righting arm curve - the angle of static equilibrium the figure annotates as the angle of heel due to grain shift - and that angle of equilibrium must not be offered as A 7.1.2 clause text because the word appears nowhere in the Code as adopted.
deliberately_unchanged: The A 7.1.2 quotation itself, shall in all conditions of loading be not less than 0.075 metre-radians, and the three upper limits enumerated as the least of three angles. All byte-identical.
The Numbers to Memorise block, whose 0.075 entry already states the between-the-curves formulation and all three upper limits.
The Common CE Failures block, which already teaches against the area up to 40 degrees short form.
The A 7.1.1 twelve-degree and deck-edge propositions and the A 7.1.3 0.30 m proposition, in every block that states them.
The 15 and 25 degree assumed-shifted-surface propositions and the B 1.3 / B 1.5 vertical-shift factors.
The On My Vessel block, which is honest about not operating the regime and was not opened.
QB2_A#q33, which is ACCEPTED on this issue. It was NOT modified for symmetry, on the brief explicit instruction, and is byte-identical.
QB2_A#q27, corrected under CORR-GPT-T2C-ONMYVESSEL-20260905 for a different defect in a different block.
